prototypeCrosslink.limitation: Prototype trim/wheels are not proven; coefficients belong to the tested vehicle.

sources.summaryMember: 2016 Chevrolet Volt/D3 Master Summary List - 2016 Chevrolet Volt 72F.pdf
sources.summaryLocator: page 1 Vehicle Setup Information; charge-depleting rows by test ID and repetition
sources.attribution: Downloadable Dynamometer Database; Advanced Powertrain Research Facility; Argonne National Laboratory; US Department of Energy

derivation.batteryBasis: Trapezoidal integral of measured current times voltage; positive discharge, negative charge
derivation.wheelBasis: Reconstructed target coastdown plus translational inertia; raw dyno effort retained separately
derivation.acceleration: Central secant of measured speed/time; one-sided at file endpoints; no smoothing
derivation.integration: Trapezoidal; clip signed wheel power before integration; consecutive integer phase endpoints only
derivation.fuelScreen: Engine speed exactly zero and abs(modal fuel) <= 0.01 g/s; analyst noise screen, not an instrument accuracy specification

split.basis: Exploratory split after initial data inspection; whole test IDs; holdout UDDS continues the same depletion campaign, not independent external validation
